   ▪ the sender information is complete (the fields “sender information”, “sender organisation” and
       “sender identifier”).

It is important that MAHs comply with the checks listed below when submitting electronic ICSRs to
ensure that reports are not automatically rejected (negative ACK log) by the system.

f.title: Act on acknowledgement codes: AE needs action for some ICSRs, AR needs the whole transaction resent
f.statement: Acknowledgement codes: AA = message successfully processed, no further action; AE = error detected, some ICSR message(s) need further action; AR = parsing error, no data extracted, re-send the entire transaction. At ICSR level, CA = ICSR successfully loaded; CR = ICSR contains a fatal error preventing loading.
f.clause: 7.5 Processing and acknowledgement of receipt of ICSRs

rows.quote:
ACK code AA: Application Acknowledgement Accept (message successfully processed, no
         further action)
         ACK code AE: Application Acknowledgment Error (error detected, error response has
         additional detail, some ICSR message(s) need further action)
         ACK code AR: Application Acknowledgment Reject (parsing error, no data extracted, re-send
         the entire transaction)
         The Acknowledgement Message can reflect two different types of transmission
         acknowledgements at ICSR level:
         ICSR code CA: Commit Accept (the ICSR message was successfully loaded)
         ICSR code CR: Commit Reject (the ICSR message contains a fatal error that prevents the
         ICSR from being loaded)
rows.location: 7.5 Processing and acknowledgement of receipt of ICSRs
rows.review_note: Review: level Mandatory -> Recommended (extractor flag decided): the ACK code list defines codes in the present tense; the only actions are descriptive ('need further action', 're-send the entire transaction').
